title: Public Hermes hook input and admission binding

x-tool-input.api_request_id: opaque provider attempt, never a product run id

x-binding.authority: existing RunAdmission and its durable storage
x-binding.authentication: Existing internal credential is scoped by server composition to its configured native profile. Payloads cannot select a profile, principal, scope, product run or generation.
root_evidence: native session confirmed by create/status response or exact reserved session
sha256 of the current public user_message or the last public user history row equals the immutable submitted input; a newer unmatched user row cannot reuse an earlier source
previously unseen nonempty public turn_id and task_id
x-binding.root_ambiguity: Reject duplicate input reservations and mismatched/late turns. Retained evidence is fenced to reservations present when observed; it cannot acquire a future grant. Never choose the only active run.
children: subagent_start joins exact parent_session_id and parent_turn_id with parent_subagent_id when present
child_session_id and child_subagent_id are recorded before a child turn may bind
depth has no special-case limit; all links must belong to the same admission
tools: resolve public turn_id plus task_id in the authenticated profile
session_id must match an observed session alias or the bound root conversation
product context is injected from admission; ignore identity in args
x-binding.compression: An already bound turn/task may observe a new session alias through pre_api_request, subagent_start or on_session_end. A new turn still requires its own immutable input/history evidence.
x-binding.loss: Missing, late, conflicting or unverified evidence refuses capability execution; verify through native create/status and replay matching evidence. No exactly-once guarantee.
x-binding.terminal: Session end closes its public turn for new tools. Child stop may update the original activity after parent termination; it never authorizes another run.
x-binding.recovery: Persist reservation and public turn/child evidence under the admission authority; recover exact original bindings, never reassign to the current run.

x-media.package_output: Existing receipt.v1 structuredContent and public MCP Text/Image/Resource content
x-media.complete_receipt: Platform validates and admits once; gateway transform passes original package content unchanged
x-media.legacy: Only plain text without package receipt uses a replacement string
x-media.failure: pre RPC failure blocks; legacy transform RPC failure returns an unknown receipt
